title: Table S5. Adjusted high-microcystin contrasts for 18 MAG-derived resistance-candidate drug classes
subtitle: Original submitted model: site, season and water-temperature adjustment; effect estimates, 95% confidence intervals and model-based minimum detectable effects.
notes: 1. Candidate counts summarize RGI matches in representative MAGs assigned to their origin samples. The contrast compares high (>1.0 µg/L) with low (≤1.0 µg/L) microcystin conditions, adjusted for site, season and water temperature.
2. Coefficients and their confidence limits are on the log₂(candidate count + 1) scale. Confidence intervals are pointwise 95% ordinary least squares (OLS) intervals without multiplicity adjustment.

3. Ratios and ratio confidence limits are obtained as 2 raised to the corresponding coefficient or limit. They describe adjusted geometric-mean ratios of candidate count + 1, not fold changes in directly measured ARG abundance.
4. P values are two-sided OLS tests. Q values retain the original Benjamini–Hochberg (BH) adjustment across 1,064 functional features.

5. MDE₈₀ is the effect magnitude required for 80% power under a fixed-design OLS, noncentral-t approximation using the estimated residual variance, 92 residual degrees of freedom and two-sided α = 0.05/18 (Bonferroni). It is not the power of the original 1,064-feature BH procedure.
